dedupe_keys.name: flowlogo an agent based platform for simulating complex human aquifer interactions in managed groundwater systems

description: Juan Castilla-Rho published FlowLogo as a platform coupling groundwater-flow calculations with agent-based simulation in NetLogo. It solves two-dimensional groundwater flow using finite differences and supports steady-state and transient runs. Its configurable elements include fixed-head, constant-flux and no-flow boundaries, recharge and discharge wells, evapotranspiration, drains, springs and rivers. Coverage is a configurable aquifer setting; grid resolution and time steps depend on the model configuration. It supports simulation of managed groundwater systems and the behaviour of water users. The published implementation is limited to two dimensions. Possible extension to three-dimensional aquifers is described as future development and is not recorded as an available feature. Release 1.0.0 is available free through the CoMSES code repository and lists NetLogo. The release licence is GPL-3.0. Source code and model data were not downloaded or executed. Related resources include the CoMSES computational model library.
